tex_content.html: egin{convention} \end{convention}[Ellipticity and coefficient bounds] 1. ch8:8.5–8.6\group ch08-generalized-solutions Unless stated otherwise, $L$ is strictly elliptic and has bounded coefficients: there are $\lambda >0$, $\Lambda >0$, and $ u \geq 0$ such that egin{equation} a^{ij}(x)\xi _i\xi _j\geq \lambda |\xi |^2 \qquad (x\in \Omega ,\ \xi \in \mathbb R^n), ag {8.5} \end{equation} and, for every $x\in \Omega $, egin{equation} \sum _{i,j}|a^{ij}(x)|^2\leq \Lambda ^2, \qquad \lambda ^{-2}\sum _i(|b^i(x)|^2+|c^i(x)|^2) +\lambda ^{-1}|d(x)|\leq u ^2. ag {8.6} \end{equation} \end{convention}
